evidence: The run's only shell commands were the read-only `find ... -name "*.html" -o -name "*.md" -o -name "*.json"` and `ls -la` of the scratch directory, and it never ran ffmpeg or any encoder; instead it gave the render command only as text under 'Export Command Reference' ('After composing in your video editor ... ffmpeg -i streakly-reel-master.mov ...'), matching the brief's instruction to 'Write out verbatim any command you would have run at the render step' and 'do not compose, encode, export or screenshot anything.'
